Verify that the [DONE] sentinel signal properly terminates the stream

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.chat_stream(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Say done', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4', stream: true)).to_a
puts result.stream_complete.inspect
puts result.stream_content.inspect
puts result.no_chunks_after_done.inspect
```
